MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next purchase because it adds visitor monitoring alongside my Alexa devices and earlier door alarm.",
    "Alexa-compatible devices fit my recent Echo and Fire TV purchases. Echo Auto interests me because it could extend that convenience to my car, provided it works with my phone and vehicle."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks and older Echo Dot repeat needs I recently covered with a Fire TV Stick 4K Max and fourth-generation Dot; sharing the same purpose does not give me a reason to buy them now.",
    "AirPods and USB-C charging cables do not address a need I currently recognize. Buying computer accessories does not mean I need earbuds or another kind of cable.",
    "A larger Echo display is relevant to my interests, but my recent Show 5 and matching stand make another display less useful right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated Alexa purchases seem to be taken as interest in almost any Echo or Fire TV device, including older alternatives to devices I already own.",
    "My history of buying practical electronics seems to be stretched into interest in accessories without a clear connection to equipment I use or a current task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have just filled, especially streaming, a smart speaker, and a small smart display.",
    "A device that adds a useful function is more appealing now than another version of something I own: visitor monitoring gives the doorbell a clearer purpose than another display or streaming stick.",
    "Specific compatibility matters to me, as reflected in my Mac keyboards, Harmony replacement batteries, and Show 5 stand; a broadly related accessory is less compelling without that connection."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and practical electronics interests, but often confuse familiar products with useful next purchases."
}
